brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the village of Al-Mughayyir northeast of Ramallah on Wednesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion resulted in multiple cases of gas inhalation injuries among Palestinian residents exposed during the military operation.

Video footage documented the effects of the raid, capturing residents affected by the inhalation injuries sustained as Israeli forces entered and moved through the village. The Wednesday evening operation was part of continued military activity in the Ramallah district, an area that has experienced repeated Israeli raids in recent months.
